description: BASELINE: binary voting production strategy. Sharpe 9.39 live. Per-regime stability: bull 0.788, crash 0.785, sideways 0.782, rally 0.778. All DD safe.

architectural: factor-block voter grouping (6 correlated voters -> 4 independent blocks; intra-block averaging). Composite +0.13, raw +0.18, but sideways stab -0.003 (block-averaging dilutes opposing-side damping when signals are weak near 50/threshold). All DD safe. Branch-eligible by composite criterion but session caps at 1 experiment.

architectural: 7th cross-asset trend voter (mean ret_long of OTHER symbols, asymmetric tanh contribution). Composite +0.49, raw +0.34, all regimes pass DD. Stability essentially flat (0.7777 vs 0.778) — fails composite keep "no regression" by 0.0003 (within rounding). Strong branch candidate (per-regime: bull -0.004, crash +0.011, sideways -0.005, rally +0.002).
architectural: strong-consensus quorum entry (>=3 voters with conf>=0.70). composite +0.24, raw +0.04, but min_stab -0.003 (rally 0.7747 worst). Opening branch to fix rally stab.
branch step 7 (tighten PEAK_PROFIT_GIVEBACK 0.25->0.22): rally DD 6.085 still breaches 6.0 cap, min_stab 0.776 vs baseline 0.778. Marginal vs step 6.

branch step 8: replaced binary STRONG_QUORUM count with margin-weighted sum (sum of 2*(c-0.5) for c>0.5, threshold 1.5). Composite +0.62, raw +0.52, min_stab +0.0015 (composite keep path). All DDs safe (bull 5.38, crash 5.26, sideways 5.19, rally 5.30). Closes the open branch successfully.

architectural: continuous trend-alignment replaces hard trend_avg>0 gate (tanh requirement scaling). composite -0.04, raw -0.07, min_stab +0.0022 (under +0.003). Sideways stab +0.007 strong signal but overall under threshold. Branch-eligible but trying other independent angles first.

architectural: soft exit continuous fraction reduction (pressure 0.7->1.2 ramps target close 0->100%). Composite -0.82, raw 6.87 BELOW 7.19 floor, min_stab 0.736 (worse). Gradual exits amplify path dependency.

architectural: removed meanrev fallback entry path (eliminates 2 hard thresholds at ret_long=0.05 and RSI=49/51). composite -0.003, raw -0.005, min_stab -0.0026 (rally stab dropped 0.781->0.777). Meanrev contributed to rally noise immunity.

architectural: continuous trend-alignment requirement scaling. composite -0.04, raw -0.07, min_stab +0.0022 (rally limiter 0.7817). Sideways +0.007. Branch goal: lift rally stab to push min_stab over +0.003 threshold.
branch step 2 (req range 0.85x-1.5x): min_stab 0.7809 (-0.0008 vs step1). Bonus side increased noise.
branch step 3 (vote margin > 0.3): min_stab 0.7775. Sideways dropped 0.7865->0.7775. Margin too aggressive.
branch step 4 (vote margin 0.15): min_stab 0.7823 (+0.0028 vs baseline). Rally 0.7823 is limiter. Just under +0.003 keep threshold.
branch step 5 (divisor 0.025): min_stab 0.7803 (-0.002 vs step4). Wider divisor degrades.
branch step 6 (divisor 0.012): min_stab 0.7816 (-0.0007 vs step4). Sharper hurts sideways.
branch step 7 (req 1.0x-1.7x, divisor 0.018): min_stab 0.7820 (-0.0003 vs step4). Marginal.
branch step 8 (vote margin 0.20): min_stab 0.7802. Worse than step 4 (0.15).
branch step 9 (trend-adaptive margin 0.30->0.0): composite/raw match baseline, but min_stab 0.7772 (rally dropped). No margin in strong trend reintroduces noise.
branch step 10 (step4 + remove meanrev): min_stab 0.7797. Meanrev removal still hurts rally.
branch step 11 (cooldown floor 1+trend*1.5): min_stab 0.7390. Catastrophic — wider cooldown amplified path divergence.

BRANCH SUMMARY (11 steps): continuous trend-alignment requirement scaling (architectural). Best step 4 reached min_stab 0.7823 (+0.0028 vs baseline) — just under +0.003 keep threshold. Iterations on margin (0.15/0.20/0.30/adaptive), divisor (0.012/0.018/0.025), req scaling (1.0x-1.5x/1.7x), meanrev removal, cooldown lift all failed to lift rally stab over 0.7823. 7-step stagnation triggered termination.

architectural: certainty-weighted vote gate (sum of conf*|2c-1|, threshold 1.5). Composite +0.02, raw -0.01, min_stab 0.7818 (+0.0027 vs baseline). All 4 regimes stab improved (bull +0.002, crash +0.011, sideways +0.003, rally +0.004). Just under +0.003 keep threshold by 0.0003. Branch goal: tune CERTAINTY_MIN to push min_stab over 0.003.
branch step 2 (CERTAINTY_MIN 1.7): composite +0.06 raw +0.07 but min_stab dropped to 0.7783 (rally limiter). Step 1 sweet spot.
branch step 3 (CERTAINTY_MIN 1.3): looser gate. min_stab 0.7795. Worse than step 1.
branch step 4 (extend gate to meanrev): min_stab 0.7781. Worse.
branch step 5 (certainty-weighted size mult): min_stab 0.7803. Worse (sideways limiter).
branch step 6 (certainty gate on entries only, not flips): min_stab 0.7797. Worse.
branch step 7 (STRONG_WEIGHT_MIN 1.5->1.6): min_stab 0.7786. Worse.
branch step 8 (widen tanh divisors 1.5x): composite +0.17 raw +0.22 BIG GAIN but rally stab 0.7778 (-0.0012 vs baseline). Composite-keep fails on stab regression.
branch step 9 (partial widening 1.25x): composite +0.15 raw +0.19. Sideways limiter at 0.7792. Still regress vs baseline.
branch step 10 (step 8 + tighter certainty 1.7): composite +0.18 raw +0.23. Rally stab 0.7769. Tighter gate didn't recover rally.
branch step 11 (widen price voters only, slope tight): min_stab 0.7769. Selective widening worse.
branch step 12 (quadratic certainty weighting c*(2|c-0.5|)^2): min_stab 0.7799. Linear weighting better.

BRANCH SUMMARY (12 steps): certainty-weighted vote gate (architectural). Step 1 best at min_stab 0.7818 (+0.0027 vs baseline 0.779) — 0.0003 short of +0.003 keep threshold. Step 8 (widened tanh) gave composite +0.17 raw +0.22 but rally stab regressed -0.0012, failing composite-keep. Iterations on certainty threshold (1.3/1.5/1.7), gate placement (entry/flip/meanrev), size scaling, tanh widening, voter selectivity, quadratic weighting all failed to lift min_stab above step 1. 7-step stagnation triggered. Architectural insight preserved: certainty-weighted gate is structurally near keep — single voter-level fix could push it over.

architectural: position-target hysteresis (suppress same-side micro-adjustments < 12% of current pos). Composite -0.04, raw -0.03, min_stab 0.775 (-0.004, rally limiter). Hysteresis created stale positions during noise drift, hurting rally.

architectural: temporal entry sampling (entries/flips only on even bars per-symbol). Composite -3.66, raw 2.77 (massive collapse), all DDs breached caps (bull 7.87, crash 10.14, sideways 9.90, rally 11.55). Skipping entry bars also delays flips, so positions ride drawdowns.

architectural: voter conf clipping to [0.1, 0.9] (fusion-rule change). Composite +0.15, raw +0.20, min_stab 0.7807 (+0.0012). All regimes improved: bull -0.01 (flat), crash +0.08, sideways +0.15, rally +0.23. All DDs safe (bull 5.38, crash 5.18, sideways 5.19, rally 5.05). Composite keep path: stability >= baseline, raw >= 7.19, DD safe.

architectural simplification: remove meanrev fallback on top of voter-conf clipping baseline. Composite -0.01, raw -0.01, min_stab 0.7786 (-0.0021 vs e2854d7 baseline; rally limiter dropped). Meanrev still contributes rally noise immunity.

architectural: voter agreement count gate (>=4 of 6 lean) on top of clipped baseline. Composite -1.30, raw 6.14 BELOW 7.19 floor, sideways DD 6.96 BREACH 5.6 cap, min_stab 0.776 (rally regress). Count threshold too strict — clipped voters rarely have 4+ leaning hard.
architectural: per-voter EMA conf smoothing (alpha=0.4). Composite -3.68, raw 1.32 catastrophic, all DDs 12-16% breach caps, min_stab 0.739. EMA stickiness creates late entries that ride drawdowns.

architectural: asymmetric voter smoothing (fast on conviction, slow on retreat). Composite -999 (zero trades). Ratchet only accepts outward moves, eventually freezing both bull and bear confs high so neither side can dominate gates.

architectural: voter abstain zone in strong-sum (conf in [0.4, 0.6] contributes 0). Composite +0.82 raw -0.29 (still>=7.19), min_stab 0.7803 (-0.0004 vs baseline). Rally limiter 0.7803. Strong composite gain — branch goal: lift rally stab.
branch step 2 (abstain zone [0.35,0.65]): composite +1.19 raw +0.19 vs orig baseline, but rally stab 0.7774 (-0.0033). Wider zone hurts rally noise immunity.
branch step 3 (abstain [0.45,0.55]): composite +1.13 vs orig but min_stab 0.7764 (rally limiter, sideways also weak). Narrower worse.
branch step 4 (zone [0.4,0.6] + STRONG_WEIGHT_MIN 1.7): composite +0.79 raw 7.39 but rally stab 0.7743 worst. Tighter gate hurts rally.
branch step 5 (STRONG_WEIGHT_MIN 1.3): rally stab 0.7732 worse. Looser gate amplifies noise.
branch step 6 (cubic ramp): composite +1.21 raw +0.23 vs orig baseline. min_stab 0.7803 (-0.0004). Major progress — rally lifted 0.7732->0.7803.

branch step 7 (quintic ramp): composite +1.20, raw +0.20, min_stab 0.7809 (+0.0002 vs baseline 0.7807). Composite-keep path satisfied. All DDs safe (bull 5.38, crash 5.06, sideways 5.45, rally 5.05). Closes branch successfully — abstain-zone idea + cubic/quintic smoothing of the strong-sum eliminates gradient discontinuity at decision boundary.
